name: The Vault
source:
The task is simple. All you have to do is leave the vault. Any means will do. Provided you abide by certain conditions.

[From [url=https://dwam.itch.io/the-vault]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
任务很简单。你唯一需要做的，便是离开这座金库。无论采取什么手段都可以——前提是你必须遵守特定的附加条件。

[摘自[url=https://dwam.itch.io/the-vault]itch.io[/url]]
